lessons.title: Tokenization & Word Embeddings
lessons.description: Convert raw text strings to vector representations. Compare One-Hot, TF-IDF, Word2Vec, GloVe, and subword tokenization (BPE).

lessons.title: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) & LSTMs
lessons.description: Model sequential dependencies with hidden recurrence. Overcome vanishing gradients with LSTM and GRU gating mechanisms.

lessons.title: The Attention Mechanism
lessons.description: Break the sequence-to-sequence information bottleneck. Derive Queries, Keys, Values, and Scaled Dot-Product Attention.

lessons.title: The Transformer Architecture
lessons.description: Explore the complete Transformer architecture: Multi-Head Attention, Positional Encoding, and Encoder vs Decoder families.
